name: Psychology Today Therapist Finder
one_liner: Psychology Today's free directory lets you search therapists, psychiatrists and support groups by location, insurance and specialty.
best_for: People who want to compare many local therapists and contact them directly
People looking for a therapist who takes their insurance
People who want to filter by issue, approach or identity before reaching out
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who want a service that matches and books them automatically
People who want a single price up front (each therapist sets their own fees)
short_description: Free directory of therapists, psychiatrists and support groups. Search by location and insurance, then contact the clinician directly.
long_description: The Psychology Today therapist finder is a directory run by Sussex Directories, part of the publisher of Psychology Today. Clinicians pay to list profiles; people seeking help search for free by location and filter by insurance, issues, therapy approach, and whether the clinician offers online sessions. Psychology Today does not provide therapy, verify fit, or handle booking or payment for most listings: you contact the clinician yourself and pay their fee or use your insurance with them. Listings also include psychiatrists, treatment centers and support groups.
patient_summary: You search the directory by ZIP code or city and filter by insurance, issue, therapy type and other details, then contact a clinician directly from their profile. Searching is free; you pay the therapist their own fee or use your insurance with them.

pricing.starting_price: Free to search; therapists set their own fees
pricing.notes: The directory is free for people searching. Sessions are paid to the therapist (self-pay or insurance, depending on the clinician).

privacy.notes: Policy describes interest-based advertising with third-party ad networks and offers a 'Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information' opt-out; honors GPC signals.

faqs.q: How much does Psychology Today Therapist Finder cost?
faqs.a: Free to search; therapists set their own fees. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Psychology Today Therapist Finder before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Psychology Today Therapist Finder replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: Psychology Today Therapist Finder connects you with licensed professionals, so it can be a route into real care. It isn't an emergency service: if you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use Psychology Today Therapist Finder?
faqs.a: Psychology Today Therapist Finder is available on the web.

faqs.q: What does Psychology Today Therapist Finder include?
faqs.a: Search by ZIP and insurance; Detailed filters; Psychiatrists and support groups; Direct contact.
